report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support the operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors. All sampled checkout traces returned HTTP 200 with successful downstream calls, and order metrics show no 5xx errors. The only deployment record is a baseline v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused failure. No bounded cause is substantiated; hand off for further evidence.
missing_evidence: Error logs or traces showing actual checkout failures (non-200 status) during the incident window
Deployment history showing a version change preceding the alleged errors
Metrics for checkout/order error rates and latency over a longer window to confirm any degradation
Evidence of db-pool, redis, or downstream latency anomalies to rule out alternative causes
